title: Chapelhill, Chapelizod, Co. Dublin
description: High spec luxury, newly decorated and renovated, quality furnished large duplex available to rent in lovely quiet small development. 2 double bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and very spacious overall. On the banks of the Liffey - overlooking and right beside the Phoenix Park. Short 3 min drive to Castleknock and 5 min walk to Chapelizod village with their various pubs, restaurants, shops and Dublin Bus/train routes. 10 mins by bus to city centre and also has easy access to the M50 and all major road routes. All mod cons, cost efficient gas heating that keeps duplex warm for minimal cost, allocated secure parking. Perfect tranquil base while being very close to the city centre when required to be onsite - the best of both worlds! Apply by email providing brief details regarding prospective occupants and I will arrange a viewing of this wonderful property.
